annotations.title: Suburb · Public transport access and service

description:
Stops by mode, weekday service frequency, routes, and how many addresses are within a short walk of a stop or station, for suburbs in Victoria, South East Queensland, Perth, Adelaide, Tasmania and Darwin.

Coverage: Victoria (trains, trams, buses, coaches), South East Queensland, the Perth region and the towns its bus network serves, Adelaide and its regional services, Tasmania, and Darwin. Not covered: New South Wales, the ACT, the rest of Queensland and the Northern Territory outside Darwin. A suburb is included when it is in a covered state and within 25 km of a stop; inside that area a suburb with no service shows real zeros. Current to 2026-11-06. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/public-transport`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: stops_total, stops_bus, stops_train, stops_tram, stops_ferry, weekday_trips_total, weekday_trips_bus, weekday_trips_train, weekday_trips_tram, weekday_trips_ferry, peak_trips_per_hour_busiest_stop, routes_total, routes_bus, routes_train, routes_tram, routes_ferry, share_addr_400m_stop_pct, share_addr_800m_station_pct, median_addr_distance_to_stop_m, nearest_train_station_m. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
